subject: Configure Logfire alerts per §11.3 monitoring table
description:
Configure Logfire alerts via the alerts API (or YAML-managed equivalent) per §11.3.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Alert: delegation failure rate > 25% over 1h → AMC `notify_channel`.
- [ ] Alert: AMC `send` 5xx rate > 10% over 15m → AMC + Logfire UI.
- [ ] Alert: webhook signature failures > 5 in 5m → AMC + Logfire UI.
- [ ] Alert: daily cost at 75% of soft cap → AMC `notify_channel`.
- [ ] Alert: DBOS workflow failures > 3 in 1h → AMC + Logfire UI.
- [ ] Alert: listener handler P99 latency > 2s for 5m → Logfire UI.
- [ ] Alerts referenced by name from a checked-in config (so they can be re-applied if accidentally deleted).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Smoke: synthetic spike on each metric triggers the corresponding alert in a test Logfire project

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 9.5, 11.3
